description: JSON forbids raw U+0000 through U+001F inside a string, but fz currently returns {:ok, <<0>>} for Json.decode(<<34, 0, 34>>); Elixir returns {:error, {:invalid_byte, 1, 0}}. The ASCII fast path in Json.string/2 must reject the control range while preserving escaped forms such as \\u0000. Add an Elixir-oracled control-range fixture for string values and object keys across interp, run, and build, and update decoder documentation.

comments.text: Implemented in f314a1386. Json.string/2 now rejects raw bytes 0..31 before the general ASCII path and returns the untouched suffix, so decode/1 reports Elixir-compatible offsets for both values and object keys. Escaped controls remain accepted through the existing escape path. Added an exhaustive Elixir-oracled fixture across interp/run/build and updated Json.decode/1 docs. title: Json.decode accepts unescaped control bytes inside strings
